description: Photo by Elsa Olofsson on Pexels.com I support full legalization of cannabis (marijuana). Recreational use is less dangerous than alcohol, and should be regulated similarly. Nobody loses a job opportunity for off-the-clock alcohol use; nobody should lose a job opportunity for off-the-clock cannabis use. It's time to do the right thing Any conversation about legalization…
